text: Drake Maye and the Patriots are gearing up for their 2026 home opener against the Pittsburgh Steelers on Sunday, September 20 at 1 PM ET at Gillette Stadium, though the team faces a significant challenge with wide receiver A.J. Brown landing on injured reserve after suffering a high ankle sprain in Week 1—a setback that will sideline him for at least four games and force others to step up in his absence. Meanwhile, off the field, the Patriots organization has been actively engaged in community work, with Maye and his wife Ann Michael funding Amazon classroom wish lists for over 50 teachers and staff at Alfred Lima Sr. Elementary School in Providence, while the Kraft family and Patriots Foundation donated $275,000 in the names of 26 Myra Kraft Community MVP Award winners, including a $25,000 grand prize to Susie Shaw of Carlisle for William's Be Yourself Challenge. In roster moves, the team re-signed safety Elliott Davison to the practice squad and released tight end Shane Zylstra, and owner Robert Kraft also made headlines by stating that rapper Macklemore would not perform as an opening act for Ed Sheeran's shows at Gillette Stadium due to what Kraft described as a "history of antisemitic rhetoric and imagery that we believe has been deeply offensive and hurtful to the Jewish community
